name: supabase
title_zh: 自带 Postgres 的 Web 后端
tagline_zh: 不想碰服务器又想用真 Postgres？它给你专属实例，连 Auth、存储、实时订阅都配好，前端直接连。
tagline_en: Skip server ops but keep real Postgres. Get a dedicated instance with Auth, Storage, and Realtime built.
desc_en: The Postgres development platform. Supabase gives you a dedicated Postgres database to build your web, mobile, and AI applications.
why_zh: 不是模拟器，是每个项目一个真 Postgres 实例。表结构、行级安全、数据库函数全按你写的来。
why_en: Not an emulator—each project gets a real Postgres instance. Tables, RLS, and DB functions behave exactly as written; your.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Postgres 生态内的需求。要接非 Postgres 数据源、跑复杂定时任务。
limit_en: Only covers Postgres-ecosystem needs. No non-Postgres data sources, no complex cron jobs, no custom domains or multi-region deploys—you'd need to.
